title: LuEngine
author: __RLocksley__
selftext:
LuEngine is a high performance C++ Game Engine (MIT licensed, work in progress) with flecs ecs as the Game API and and a glsl shader API.

The flecs ecs API is very general, performant, and let you express complex game code with fewer tokens.

LuEngine is designed such that a Game Developer / Agent can define the game 100% by code.

The renderer is Vulkan based.

Features:

3D:  
Mesh - you just set a component, an observer talks to the render thread.  
MultiMesh - with the option to manipulate the instances with compute shaders  
SkeletonMesh - animate hundreds of skeletons with complex animation-graphs  
Physics (JoltPysics integration) - rigid body, sensors, character capsule, heightfields

2D:  
Mesh - with signed distance function option for beautiful widgets  
Text - just supply a .ttf file, also with sdf option  
UI - complex UI as entity tree (like Button, List, Matrix,...)

Just let an agent clone the repository and tell it to read the [ReadMe.md](http://ReadMe.md) for setting it up and understand the engine.  
There are 20 examples where your agent can learn.  

[https://github.com/Rlocksley/LuEngine](https://github.com/Rlocksley/LuEngine)
